titlebar.world.label: World
titlebar.world.help: The world this screen is generating, with the seed it grew from. The seed alone reproduces it.
titlebar.status.new.label: Not saved yet
titlebar.status.new.help: This world exists only in this tab and is gone when it closes.
titlebar.status.unsaved.label: Unsaved changes
titlebar.status.unsaved.help: This world has changed since it was last saved, loaded or regenerated.
titlebar.status.local.label: Saved in browser · {when}
titlebar.status.local.help: Kept in this browser only. Clearing site data removes it.
titlebar.status.server.label: Saved to server · {when}
titlebar.status.server.help: Kept on the server and can be opened from another browser.
titlebar.language.de.label: Deutsch
titlebar.language.en.label: English
titlebar.signIn.label: Sign in
titlebar.signIn.help: Sign in to the server to keep worlds beyond this browser.
titlebar.account.label: Account: {user}
titlebar.account.help: Signed in as {user}. Click to sign out.
titlebar.save.browser.label: Keep in this browser
titlebar.save.browser.help: Stored in this browser's own space. It survives a reload, but the browser may clear it and another device cannot see it.
titlebar.save.server.label: Store on server
titlebar.save.server.help: Stored on the server, reachable from any browser you sign in from. Needs a sign-in.
titlebar.save.download.label: Download as .zip
titlebar.save.download.help: Written to a file you keep yourself. Nothing here holds it afterwards — open the file again to continue.
